assessment.summary: EGFR (P00533) is one of the most extensively drugged targets in oncology, with numerous approved small-molecule inhibitors (e.g., erlotinib, gefitinib, osimertinib) and therapeutic antibodies (e.g., cetuximab, panitumumab) in clinical use. The structural evidence is exceptional, with 20 PDB structures including a 1.07 Å resolution crystal structure and 19 ligand-bound complexes. The ChEMBL 'not found' result is a clear data pipeline error (timeout), not a genuine absence of chemical matter — EGFR has thousands of documented inhibitors in ChEMBL and beyond.
evidence_gaps: ChEMBL data retrieval failed due to a read timeout — this is a pipeline artifact, not a true data gap; EGFR is extensively represented in ChEMBL with >10,000 bioactivity entries
AlphaFold pLDDT (75.9 mean, 70.7% high-confidence fraction) is moderate, but this is superseded by the wealth of experimental PDB structures
No approved drugs listed in the pipeline output — again a pipeline/data retrieval artifact, not reflective of the actual clinical landscape
